extension.description: Automatically mutes bad words during video playback using subtitle timing. Works with local files and streaming add-ons such as ororo.tv.
extension.disclaimer: Mute accuracy depends on subtitle timing.
extension.news: 1.5.0: - Fix false positives caused by overly greedy wildcards (sh*t no longer matches "shift", c*nt no longer matches "count"). - Ship a curated word list. Innocent/common words (god, hell, abuse, etc.) are no longer muted by default. - Use the active video player for subtitle discovery instead of a hardcoded player id.
